purpose: Recover signed density-transfer and zero-crossing diagnostics without confusing integration gauge, output gauge, or total-variable definitions.

variable_mapping.class_integration_gauge: newtonian because synchronous initialization rejects zero CDM
variable_mapping.class_mPk_variable: delta_m selected by fourier.c index_pk_m; default matter_source_in_current_gauge=false adds 3 a H theta_m/k^2, giving the documented gauge-invariant comoving density
variable_mapping.class_transfer_column: d_m, not d_tot; d_tot also contains non-matter radiation and has a different normalization denominator
variable_mapping.camb_density_variable: delta_tot, the synchronous-gauge CDM+baryon+massive-neutrino density; massive neutrinos are zero here
variable_mapping.camb_native_scaling: get_matter_transfer_data returns delta_tot/k^2; multiply by q^2 with q in 1/Mpc to recover signed delta_tot
variable_mapping.crosscode_boundary: CLASS comoving-gauge-invariant d_m and CAMB synchronous delta_tot are not directly identical; compare sign/zero crossings and each code's own normalization before any amplitude comparison

normalization.transfer: unit initial curvature for adiabatic perturbations
normalization.power: P(k)=2 pi^2 As (k/k_pivot)^(ns-1) T(k)^2/k^3 in Mpc^3; multiply by h^3 and divide k by h for h units

analysis.signed_interpolation: linear values on log10(k), never log(abs(T)) and never extrapolation
analysis.zero_crossing: exact zeros and sign changes, linearly interpolated in natural log(k); no amplitude threshold or smoothing
analysis.phase_boundary: zero crossings are phase diagnostics only; no Hilbert transform, unwrapped phase, or unique cross-code oscillation identification
analysis.crossing_comparison: directed nearest-neighbor distances in ln(k), reporting median and maximum; unequal crossing counts remain explicit
analysis.power_reconstruction: compare reconstructed native-transfer power with existing saved/interpolated P(k), reporting median, p95 and maximum absolute fractional differences

camb_run_plan: Run zero and baseline at fiducial, high and ultra using unchanged build_params; save native transfer_data and reconstructed power.
boundaries: No change to physical densities, recombination, initial power, dark energy, or nonlinear settings.
P_k_max_h/Mpc=2.0 only makes the transfer output cover the existing bands.
No observational likelihood, covariance, joint BBN, nonlinear calculation, or model-family exclusion.
The earlier shorthand equating CLASS Newtonian integration gauge with its output matter-density gauge is to be corrected, not propagated.
